reason: The README describes DeepSeek Harness as an open-source agent harness centered on a plugin architecture, with CLI-launched local Web UI access; orchestration is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: DeepSeek Harness 是一个基于插件架构的智能体运行与编排框架，并提供可通过命令行启动的本地 Web 界面。
summaries.en: DeepSeek Harness is a plugin-based agent harness for running and orchestrating agents with a locally launched Web UI.

capabilities: Provides an agent harness with a plugin-based architecture
Runs a local Web UI through a command-line interface
Opens or serves the local interface in a browser
